decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered 000B, 001A, 002A, 900A, 901A, Received 7 September 2011, 905, 005, Received 5 October 2011, 902B, Received 13 October 2011, Design and Access Statement, Received 31 August 2011, Email from Kate Matthews, dated and received 5 October 2011, Email from Kate Matthews, dated and received 13 October 2011  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The rating level of any noise generated by plant & equipment as part of the development shall be at least 10 dB below the pre-existing background level as determined by BS4142: 1997-"Method of rating industrial noise affecting mixed residential and industrial areas".

Condition : 4 - Activities relating to the collection of refuse and recyclables and the tipping of empty bottles into external receptacles shall only take place between 07.00 and 23.00 Monday to Saturday and 09.00 and 20.00 on Sundays and Bank Holidays.
Condition : 5 - The use of the restaurant at 217 - 221 Chiswick High Road shall not be carried out outside the hours of 08.00 and 24.00, Monday to Sunday.

Condition : 6 - No building or use hereby permitted shall be occupied or the use commenced until the refuse store, and area/facilities allocated for storing of recyclable materials, as shown on the approved plans have been completed in accordance with the approved plans. Thereafter, all refuse and recyclable materials associated with the development shall either be stored within this dedicated store/area, as shown on the approved plans, or internally within the building that form part of the application site. No refuse or recycling material shall be stored or placed for collection on the public highway or pavement, except on the day of collection.
Condition : 7 - The two fire exit doors within the rear elevation of the building shall only be used for emergency purposes and refuse purposes.
description: Change of use of ground and basement floors from A1 use to A3 for use in connection with the existing restaurant at 219-221 and first floor of 217 Chiswick High Road.
